criteria.requirement: Fix docutils.__main__.main ImportError handling so missing reader/parser/writer reports failure on stderr, exits nonzero and emits no stdout document/help hint or target artifact. Preserve explicit --traceback reraising with stack and normal successful HTML publication/exit. Do not swallow failures as success, change valid component selection or broadly catch arbitrary developer exceptions. Demonstrate actual python -m docutils subprocess behavior with isolated config.
